items.title: Bernard Steinau Interview, 1978-08-02
items.q: We didn't get the 10 until we got to Dallas and picked up Adam Harding.

ctx.x: One of him at that time. See, it was a small, it wasn't a great big band. It was Don Albin and his 10 pals. Who was the 10 then? It wasn't even 10 then. We didn't get the 10 until we got to Dallas and picked up Adam Harding. Then you picked up a bass, who was the bass, sir? No, we picked up Henry Turner, playing tuba. I never heard a scene of him before. Oh, well, he was the first one in the band? Yeah, I never seen or heard of him before in my life. Mm-hmm.
You didn't have a string bass at that time?
